svg.text: Implicit Braun Heap Indexing & Exact MBU Toffoli Theorem:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Pointer-Free Bijection: Node i has children (2i + 1, 2i + 2) with size_diff in {0, 1}.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Zero QROAM / Zero Address Routing: All wire connections are static compile-time indices!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Exact Popcount Toffoli Count for k = 2^r Leaves:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: SUM_{l=1}^r (2^{r-l} * l) - r = 2^r - 1 = k - 1 Toffolis (0 Uncompute CCX)

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • For k=256 SimHash: 255 Compute Toffolis + 0 Uncompute Toffolis in depth O(log^2 k).

svg.text: • Logical Width Champion: Architecture B reaches 896 Q on RSA-2048 (1,728 Q on RSA-4096)

svg.text: by streaming the 68 independent 31-bit RNS channels through a single active 31-bit ALU.

svg.text: • The RNS CRT Tax: Because mod N reductions are non-linear across prime moduli, every

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: modular multiplication requires a full k=68 BraunTree CRT base extension (11.79B Toffolis,

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Takeaway: Use Arch B when strictly qubit-capped (< 1,000 Q); use Arch C for min spacetime!
